anchors.quote: A license overrides that default and permits the activity.
Suspension is an exception to the licensing exception and denies permission even if licensed.
Suspension without a license does not grant permission.

assumptions: The supplied booleans completely describe licensing and suspension for the activity being evaluated.
interpretation: Permission defaults to denied. Licensing permits the activity, subject to a further exception denying permission when licensed and suspended. Thus permission is allowed exactly when licensed and not suspended; suspension without licensing leaves the default denial in force.
source:
```catala
scope Permission:
  label baseRule definition allowed equals false

  label permitRule exception baseRule definition allowed under condition licensed consequence equals true

  exception permitRule definition allowed under condition licensed and not suspended consequence equals false
```
